name: Smitacs CBT Ujian
author: smitacs

sections.description:
Smitacs CBT Exam is a WordPress plugin designed to build an online examination system (Computer Based Test / CBT) easily and professionally directly from your website.

Plugin ini dirancang sebagai aplikasi cbt gratis (selama 3 bulan dan baru membayar lisensi) untuk berbagai kebutuhan seperti:

  • Schools and educational institutions
  • Sekolah dan lembaga pendidikan
  • Online training and certification
  • lembaga bimbingan belajar
  • Website e-learning WordPress
  • Online course platform
  • SaaS education platform
  • BUMDes dan lembaga desa
  • WordPress-based e-learning platforms
  • Online Saas
  • online exams – online exam and online quiz

Dengan plugin ini, Anda dapat:

  • Create and manage online exams (membuat ujian online)
  • Import questions via CSV (import soal)
  • Set exam duration with timer (mengatur waktu ujian)
  • Automatic scoring system (penilaian otomatis)
  • Display exam results instantly (hasil ujian langsung)

Features

  • CBT (Computer Based Test) system
  • Plugin ujian online WordPress
  • Online exam plugin for WordPress
  • Plugin tryout online
  • Import questions via CSV
  • Import soal menggunakan CSV
  • Per-exam timer system
  • Auto scoring / penilaian otomatis
  • Frontend exam dashboard
  • User exam result page
  • WordPress user integration
  • Online quiz and test system
  • Scalable and developer-friendly structure
  • online exam wordpress
  • computer based test wordpress
  • online quiz plugin
  • exam system wordpress
  • online test plugin
  • e-learning wordpress
  • tryout online

External Services

Plugin ini terhubung dengan API:
https://api.simolawp.com

Digunakan untuk:
– Mengambil data lisensi

Data yang dikirim:
– UUID
– Data website pengguna

Terms:
https://simolawp.com/terms-and-conditions/

Privacy:
https://simolawp.com/privacy-policy-2/

Shortcode Usage

Use the following shortcode:

  • [smitacscbt_exam_list]
    Displays the list of available exams for users.

  • [smitacscbt_exam_start]
    Displays the exam session interface including timer, navigation, and questions.

  • [smitacscbt_exam_result]
    Displays user exam results and scores.

These shortcodes are automatically inserted into pages generated during plugin activation.

Shortcode ini otomatis digunakan pada halaman yang dibuat saat plugin diaktifkan.

Configuration

No complex configuration required after installation.

Langkah penggunaan:
1. Add tes atau ujian yang akan dibuat pada cbt exam lalu Set exam duration (atur waktu) kemudian publish
2. Add exam questions (tambah soal) pada soal tes import
3. Semua tes akan muncul di halaman daftar tes
4. klik menu ujian pada daftar tes untuk memulai ujian sesuai yang diinginkan
sections.installation:
1. Upload plugin to /wp-content/plugins/
  2. Activate plugin via WordPress Plugins menu
  3. Plugin automatically creates the following pages during activation:

  • Dashboard Ujian
    Uses shortcode:
    [smitacscbt_exam_list]

  • Mulai Ujian
    Uses shortcode:
    [smitacscbt_exam_start]

  • Hasil Ujian
    Uses shortcode:
    [smitacscbt_exam_result]

These pages are used to display exam lists, start exam sessions, and show exam results on the frontend.

  1. You may also create pages manually and insert the shortcodes above if needed.
sections.faq:
Is this plugin free?

No, you can use the plugin immediately after installation for free in 3 months. and will charged Rp. 149.000

Can it be used for schools or others?

Yes. Sangat cocok untuk sekolah, bimbingan belajar, kursus online, pelatihan, dan ujian online maupun tes online.

Does it support exam timer?

Yes. Each exam can have its own timer.

Is scoring automatic?

Yes. The system automatically calculates exam results.

Do users need to login?

Optional. Can be integrated with WordPress user system.

Can I import questions?

Yes. You can import questions using CSV file.

Is this plugin extendable?

Yes. The plugin is modular and scalable for further development.

What pages are automatically created?

The plugin automatically creates:

  • Dashboard Ujian
  • Mulai Ujian
  • Hasil Ujian

These pages contain the required shortcodes for frontend CBT functionality.

When trouble or cannot setting who can help me?

Anda akan emndapatkan support dan dapat menghubungi WA 08563363188
